title: Hold a circus or travelling zoo permit
what: Conduct a travelling zoo, or a circus with performing animals, only under a permit.

sources.title: Animal Welfare Act 1992 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 53(1) (current republication (R36, from 6 December 2025; Animal Welfare Act 1992 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person conducts a travelling zoo; and (b) the person does not have a permit to conduct the travelling zoo

sources.title: Animal Welfare Act 1992 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 52(1) (current republication (R36, from 6 December 2025; Animal Welfare Act 1992 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person conducts a circus; and (b) the circus has performing animals (but is not a travelling zoo); and (c) the person does not have a permit to conduct the circus

reach.condition: if it conducts a travelling zoo or a circus with performing animals
